value.data: A premium residential project offering luxurious 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartments with top-tier amenities and world-class designs. Residents have access to a rooftop swimming pool, lounge deck, and fitness centre.. Configurations: 3 BHK, 4 BHK

Residents generally praise Brigade Caladium for its luxurious apartments, excellent amenities, strong security, and good construction, along with its convenient location. However, external issues like poor local road conditions, water/power supply problems, and environmental concerns are common complaints.
